newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.

text.p: Ten stocks fell, five rose and eight were flat in 8.7-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Friday with the WIG 20 index up 0.8 percent to 1,487.6 points.
In comparison with their main market fixing, 11 stocks rose, three fell and nine were flat.
The remaining seven stocks did not trade.
The National Investment Fund NIF index rose 0.7 percent to 129.3 points in 1.7-million-zloty trade.
NFI units were flat at 127 zlotys in a 4.3-million-zloty turnover.
